old_card.headline: BlueStone Jewellery pays ₹4,000 fine for 2-day delay in shareholding filing
old_card.takeaway: A minor procedural penalty with no material impact on operations or financials, now settled by the company.
old_card.core_catalyst: Administrative lapse due to misinterpretation of integrated filing provisions.

what_happened.text: NSE imposed a **₹4,000 fine** plus GST for a **2-day delay** in submitting the Q1FY27 shareholding pattern
what_happened.quote: The Company filed it on July 23, 2026, a delay of 2 days.

what_happened.text: The delay was attributed to a **misinterpretation** of integrated filing framework applicability by the filing team
what_happened.quote: The delay was inadvertent and occurred as a result of misinterpretation of the applicability of the integrated filing provisions on whether the Shareholding Pattern is/is not covered under the integrated filing framework.

what_happened.text: The company **paid the fine** on October 23, 2026, and implemented a maker-checker review process to prevent recurrence
what_happened.quote: The Company has paid the fine of Rs. 4,000 plus GST on October 23, 2026 levied vide your notice dated October 19, 2026.

why_it_matters.text: The fine is negligible for a company with a ₹11,623 Cr market cap and ₹1,836 Cr net worth.
The Board has formally advised management to ensure strict adherence to regulatory timelines following this lapse.
why_it_matters.quote: The Board advised the Management to be careful and cautious in interpreting the applicability of filing provisions, and to ensure strict adherence to regulatory timelines going forward.

key_numbers.label: Fine Amount
key_numbers.quote: Imposition of fine of Rs. 4,000/- plus GST.
